summary: Ferrari N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing a single press release dated October 16, 2026, announcing the timing of its third-quarter 2026 results. Results will be released Tuesday, November 3, 2026, with a webcast and conference call at 2:00 p.m. GMT / 3:00 p.m. CET / 9:00 a.m. EST; advance registration is required and a two-week replay will be archived. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
